author: Dan Desmond
title: Baseball: Four thoughts from Vanderbilt's weekend series against No. 16 Oklahoma - NewsBreak
text:
By Dan Desmond ,
13 hours ago Vanderbilt Baseball moved to 21-16 on the year and 7-8 in conference play after losing the last two games in its weekend series against Oklahoma at Hawkins Field. The VandyBoys had an impressive showing on Thursday, April 9, winning 10-5 with outstanding performances by Connor Fennell on the mound and Mike Mancini at the plate. Fennell went seven innings and allowed two runs while striking out 10. With 99 pitches thrown through seven, Fennell went back out for the eighth, but gave up a double to Jason Walk, who would later score in the inning and slightly tarnish Fennell’s line on the night. Mancini blasted two home runs and totaled six runs battled in (RBIs) to help power the Commodores to a victory. Read full article
